source_instruction: i am looking for standard sized levi strauss & co. men's carpenter jeans that are machine washable.
query: I stopped by the corner food cart on my walk over here, right? The guy running it was grilling up these spicy garlic chicken skewers that smelled so good I almost grabbed a plate before I remembered I’m meeting my roommate for tacos in an hour, and he’s been hyping up that new al pastor spot for three whole weeks. A couple of kids were zooming by on beat-up skateboards right outside the store entrance, laughing so loud when one of them nearly wiped out on a crack in the sidewalk that I had to pause and make sure he didn’t actually eat pavement. The sky’s that soft hazy blue it gets right before golden hour, too, and the breeze coming through the open store door smells like cut grass from the little park down the block. Right now I’m browsing the men’s jeans section. I’ve heard pairs that are totally machine washable, no special dry cleaning or hand washing required at all, are such a solid call for everyday wear. I’ve heard those fancy premium cuts or weird custom fits don’t line up with the regular option I usually go for, y’know? I’ve heard none of the options go over that one budget limit I always stick to when I’m picking up new everyday pants.
